FortressTV 2.0.0-RC12:
- Match details sheet: interactive card popup displaying live score, minute, stadium venue, and chronological goalscorers, penalties, and red cards with 1-tap playback.
- Dynamic multi-channel sports distribution: automatically resolves simultaneous kickoff matches across separate network channels (DAZN 1..6, Sport TV 1..6) and strictly prioritizes Portuguese feeds (PT:).
- Auto-refreshing sports ticker: live scores and minutes periodically update every 60 seconds on the Home screen.
- Movie poster fallback resolver: queries Cinemeta metadata for newly added VOD releases lacking stream artwork, ensuring full HD poster coverage.
